verdict.rationale: Elicit documents generating research-backed reports from any question and a Systematic Review workflow that ends in a report summarizing the relevant papers. Reports export as PDF or Word on any plan, extraction tables export to CSV/Excel, and work can be shared via a view link that works for people without an Elicit account, so the core story of producing and sharing a stakeholder-ready report is covered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the report's internal section structure and of tables embedded within the report itself, plus independent hands-on corroboration of report output quality.
